crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, dark, horizontally-oriented rectangular patch visible on the posterior neck below the white region of the head.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and non-linear transition between the head and the upper back.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, alternating black and white transverse banding across the rectrices (tail feathers).
